disclaimer: Experimental model research. No demonstrated edge: in backtests this method covered about as often as a coin flip, below the 52.4% needed to break even. Not betting advice.

method.team_strength: starters' projected half-PPR points: QB1, RB1-2, WR1-3, TE1; DEF projection

points_model_fit.source: Sleeper + ESPN + CBS mean (the site's blend) + nflverse final scores

method.line_source: nflverse schedules spread_line (open data); no capture time from source
method.lock: a game's row freezes at the last publish before kickoff

projection_map.label: Projection margin through the weekly median map, closing lines

spread_map_control.label: Closing spread through the same map (no projections)

backtest.note: Walk-forward replays graded at an assumed -110. Design choices were made after looking at recent results, so these are diagnostics, not forward evidence.
